classHint.zh: 在非简单难度击杀特殊敌人，收集掉落的奖杯，可随机解锁职业或提升当前职业等级。
classHint.en: On non-Easy difficulty, kill special enemies and collect trophies to randomly unlock a class or upgrade your current class.

unlockBody.zh:
职业解锁
在普通、困难或更难难度击杀任意种类的特殊敌人，推进奖杯掉落；不要求击败宿敌，普通骷髅不算。简单难度不掉奖杯，每局最多3个。
点击奖杯：当前非冒险者职业未满10级时，随机决定升级当前职业或尝试解锁新职业；新职业从未解锁职业中随机选择。没有未解锁职业时，回退升级可成长的当前职业。
种族解锁
对应职业达到5级，其默认种族才对其他职业开放。要更换种族的职业自身也必须达到5级。冒险者固定为人类。
这里的职业等级由奖杯提升，保存在档案中，与单局经验升级不同。
unlockBody.en:
Classes
Kill any type of special enemy on Normal, Hard or Harder to advance trophy drops. No mortal enemy is required; normal skulls do not count. Easy drops no trophies; at most 3 appear per run.
Tap a trophy: a non-Adventurer below class level 10 can randomly gain a level or attempt to unlock a class. New classes are chosen randomly from locked classes. If none remain, the current class gains a level if eligible.
Races
A class at level 5 shares its default race with other classes. A class must also reach level 5 to change its own race. Adventurer stays Human.
Class levels persist in your profile and come from trophies, separately from XP levels within a run.

raceGate.zh: 当前职业需达到5级，才能选择已解锁种族。
raceGate.en: This class must reach level 5 to choose an unlocked race.

raceChoose.zh: 可选择已解锁种族；点击图标查看条件。
raceChoose.en: Choose an unlocked race; tap any icon to inspect it.

raceLocked.zh: {race}尚未开放给其他职业：将{class}升到职业5级（当前{level}/5）。该职业从解锁起就使用此默认种族。
raceLocked.en: To share {race} with other classes, raise {class} to class level 5 (now {level}/5). That class uses this default race as soon as it is unlocked.

raceOpen.en: {race} is available: {class} has reached class level 5.

levelNote.zh: 职业等级通过奖杯成长，跨局保存。此页仅查看奖励，不改变配置。
levelNote.en: Trophies increase persistent class levels. This page previews rewards without changing your configuration.

adventurerNote.zh: 冒险者没有2–10级成长奖励，种族固定为人类。击杀特殊敌人、收集奖杯可解锁其他职业。
adventurerNote.en: Adventurer has no level 2–10 rewards and always uses Human. Kill special enemies and collect trophies to unlock other classes.

skillNote.zh: 这是职业技能池的开放，不是开局装备技能。首个职业技能仍在单局升到2级时作为候选提供。
skillNote.en: This shares a skill with other classes, not starting equipment. The class skill is offered when the character first reaches level 2 in a run.

bonus.zh: 第4格起增加双倍奖励机会
bonus.en: Each tile after 3 adds a bonus chance

shields.zh: 盾牌 → 修甲 / 强化

shop.zh: 金币槽填满 → 购买装备

repair.zh: 当前护甲 / 护甲上限

upgrade.zh: 护甲已满 → 填充强化条

levelup.zh: 经验条填满 → 单局升级
levelup.en: Fill XP → Level up this run

enemy.zh: 白：攻击  蓝：防御  红：生命
enemy.en: White: ATK · Blue: DEF · Red: HP

health.zh: 未挡住的伤害扣除生命

ready.zh: 技能就绪：按住查看，松开发动
ready.en: Ready: hold to inspect, release to cast

active.zh: 技能生效中，持续到本回合结束

special.zh: 特殊敌人：点击查看能力

loot.zh: 特殊敌人 → 金币、经验等
loot.en: Special enemy → Gold, XP and more

tutorialStart.zh: 连接3个或更多同类方块即可收集。图中绿线是一条示例路径；点击“开始练习”在棋盘上操作。
tutorialStart.en: Connect 3 or more matching tiles to collect them. The green line shows an example path. Choose Practice to try it on the board.
